summary: Radar for 2026-11-09, all GLP-1 focus. Three things matter this week. (1) Thanksgiving is now 10 days away (Nov 18–27 search peak) and has risen across 10 snapshots. It feeds the 20:00 funnel Shorts, plus a heartburn/burping long-form that the holiday makes urgent. (2) There is fresh Phase 3 retatrutide data: TRIUMPH-4 and TRIUMPH-1-OA were published in NEJM on Nov 8 (knee OA, more than 1,000 adults, about two-thirds reached 50% or more pain reduction vs 38% on placebo). It's in its first 24 h of news pickup with thin creator coverage, so it suits a 13:00 lead Short with the 'not approved / research products aren't the trial drug' line. ObesityWeek (Nov 14–17) gives a tirzepatide-first head-to-head hook if full REDEFINE 4 data appear. (3) The Lane A long-form queue in the playbook is confirmed as evergreen demand: injection site reactions (momentum 88, 11 snapshots), dehydration (sick-day and cold-season hook, label AKI warning), diarrhoea, and alcohol. Alcohol is refreshed by a new DOM target-trial emulation of semaglutide/tirzepatide in T2D (Nov 3) and the holiday drinking season. New caution-level signals: skin pain/allodynia (NewsNation Nov 6, mostly anecdotal and pharmacovigilance), NSAIDs and GI bleeding on GLP-1s (cohort, Nov 5; abstract not yet verified), and a gout/uric-acid meta-analysis (DOM, Nov 8; abstract not verified, since PubMed blocked fetching). Rejected: Hims/Lilly direct-sale, online-platform, insurance-coverage and cost stories (banned topics plus a pharmacy/online-access risk).

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide: feeling full fast, protein first, smaller plates, eating slowly, alcohol and easing nausea at a big holiday meal
candidates.angle: 'Will I be able to enjoy Thanksgiving on tirzepatide?' A calm, practical plan: why fullness comes sooner (slower gastric emptying), protein-first plates, pausing between bites, and which signs mean call your prescriber. 20:00 funnel Shorts point to the Thanksgiving long-form.
keywords: can I eat thanksgiving dinner on ozempic
candidates.why_now: Rising across 10 snapshots (81→91). The holiday search window opens in about a week, and the existing long-form needs feeder Shorts 2 days ahead of the peak.

evidence.signal: Seen 10 times, momentum 81→91, still accelerating
Pharmacist tips for using Zepbound, showing practical-use demand

candidates.topic: Retatrutide and knee osteoarthritis: TRIUMPH-4 and TRIUMPH-1-OA Phase 3 in NEJM (Nov 8). About two-thirds on retatrutide reached at least 50% knee-pain reduction vs 38% on placebo; up to about 25% average weight loss at the top dose
candidates.angle: 'Retatrutide and knee pain: what's confirmed?' Two randomized Phase 3 trials in adults with knee OA and overweight/obesity. What was measured (pain score, not joint structure), what's still unknown (whether it slows OA or avoids knee replacement), why muscle matters for knees, and a plain line that it isn't approved and online 'research' products aren't the trial drug.
candidates.why_now: Published Nov 8 and picked up within 24 h by Medical Xpress, News-Medical, NewsBytes, New Atlas and Korean outlets. Few creator videos yet. This is new Phase 3 data, which our retatrutide rule requires.

evidence.signal: TRIUMPH-4 and TRIUMPH-1-OA in NEJM, 1,000+ participants, ~two-thirds reached 50% pain reduction vs 38% on placebo
Retatrutide reduces knee pain and body weight in OA patients
'Retatrutide is one click away. That doesn't make it safe.' Gray-market context for the not-approved line

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide injection site reactions: is redness, itching or a small lump normal? Label rates of 6% (5 mg) and 8% (10 and 15 mg) vs about 2% on placebo
candidates.angle: 'Is this normal?' What a typical reaction looks like, how long it tends to last, rotating sites, and the specific signs (spreading redness, swelling of the face or throat, trouble breathing) that need urgent care. Rates given per dose, never pooled.
candidates.why_now: Seen in 11 snapshots with momentum climbing 71→88. Its Short reached 226 views by day 3. It's playbook Lane A topic #1, sits next to the big-three Side Effects video, and is refreshed by NewsNation's GLP-1 skin coverage (Nov 6).

evidence.signal: Injection site reactions with GLP-1 use may be under-recognized
GLP-1 users report a painful skin side effect

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide and dehydration on sick days: the label's acute kidney injury warning linked to vomiting or diarrhoea, heading into cold and flu season
candidates.angle: 'Tirzepatide dehydration: signs to watch for.' Why fluid loss matters more when you're eating less, the early signs (dark urine, dizziness, less urine), how to sip fluids through a stomach bug, and when to call your prescriber. No 'this flu season' wording, so it stays evergreen.
candidates.why_now: Momentum is up across 3 snapshots (70→80). It's playbook Lane A #2, and northern-hemisphere cold and stomach-bug season is starting.

evidence.signal: Seen 3 times (70→80), plus separate cold-season and Australian-heat variants
Practical Zepbound-use tips content showing demand

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide and alcohol: what the label and new evidence say, refreshed by a DOM target-trial emulation of semaglutide/tirzepatide and recorded alcohol-related outcomes in type 2 diabetes (Nov 3) and the JAMA Psychiatry survey (44.2% of drinkers on GLP-1s reported drinking less)
candidates.angle: 'Tirzepatide and alcohol: what to know' before holiday parties. Why some people feel less pull toward drinking (brain reward research, observational and survey data only), why drinking on an empty, slower stomach can hit differently, dehydration and pancreatitis context, and the low-blood-sugar caveat for anyone on insulin or a sulfonylurea. No 'safe amount'.
candidates.why_now: A new target-trial emulation came out Nov 3, it's playbook Lane A #4, and the Thanksgiving-to-New-Year drinking season is approaching, followed by Dry January.

evidence.signal: Semaglutide, tirzepatide and clinically recorded alcohol-related outcomes in T2D: target trial emulation (observational)
Small-molecule GLP-1s act on the central amygdala and reduce reward-circuit dopamine in mice

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide burping and heartburn: why it happens and what helps (slower gastric emptying, sulfur burps, reflux after big meals)
candidates.angle: 'Tirzepatide burping and heartburn: what helps.' The gastric-emptying mechanism in plain words, label rates for burping (eructation) and reflux vs placebo, eating habits that ease it (smaller portions, stopping at the first sign of fullness, not lying down after eating), and when reflux needs a doctor. Timed for the Thanksgiving big-meal week.
candidates.why_now: It's on the playbook Lane A list and sits next to Side Effects and Thanksgiving. Big-meal reflux searches rise over the holidays.

evidence.signal: Gastric emptying and residual stomach contents on GLP-1 medicines, mechanism context
Practical Zepbound tips showing demand for side-effect management

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide diarrhea: why it happens, how long it lasts and what helps
candidates.angle: 'Tirzepatide diarrhea: why it happens.' Label rates per dose vs placebo, the tendency to be worse around dose increases, fluids and gentle foods, and the dehydration and kidney warning signs that mean call your prescriber. Pairs with the dehydration video for a series.
candidates.why_now: It's on the playbook Lane A list, and stomach-bug season makes the 'is it the drug or a bug?' question timely.

evidence.signal: OMDOT-1 RCT secondary analysis of gut microbiome changes with tirzepatide and semaglutide, gut-mechanism context

candidates.topic: ObesityWeek 2026 (Nov 14–17): full REDEFINE 4, CagriSema vs tirzepatide 15 mg in 809 adults with obesity (open-label, 84 weeks; topline tirzepatide -25.5% vs CagriSema -23.0%, non-inferiority not met)
candidates.angle: A tirzepatide-first head-to-head Short in an obesity population. If the full data go public, it's 'Tirzepatide vs CagriSema: what the full trial shows', covering side effects, discontinuation and the open-label caveat. Only post if it's made public within 48 h.
candidates.why_now: The conference is 5 days away. A randomized head-to-head against tirzepatide is the one news exception the playbook allows.

evidence.signal: CagriSema achieved 23% but missed non-inferiority vs tirzepatide in REDEFINE 4
CagriSema did not meet primary endpoint of non-inferiority to tirzepatide

candidates.topic: Skin pain on tirzepatide or semaglutide: tenderness, burning or 'sunburn' feeling (allodynia / dysesthesia) when nothing is touching the skin
candidates.angle: 'Is skin pain on tirzepatide normal?' What doctors know and don't know. Mostly case reports and pharmacovigilance signals, not a confirmed label effect. How it differs from an injection site reaction, and why to tell your prescriber. No scary framing.
candidates.why_now: NewsNation (Nov 6), the Daily Beast and other outlets are covering it, people are asking about it on social media, and few evidence-based explainers exist.
